'''Bolgoink Hold ''' was the primary building of the [[Bolgoink]] settlement, and the clan hold of the [[Bolgoink clan]]. It was the chief residence of [[Vrokk]] and his wife, [[Matron/Legends|Matron]] [[Kufbrug]].<ref name="MS" />
